nav.short: The price of one unit of a mutual fund. It's updated once a day after markets close, so everyone buying that day gets the same price.
nav.example: UTI Nifty 50 Index Fund's NAV on 6 Oct 2026 was ₹160.38.

sip.short: An automatic, fixed investment on the same date every month. No timing the market, no daily decisions.

index_fund.short: A fund that copies a market index like the Nifty 50 instead of a manager picking stocks.

expense_ratio.short: The yearly fee a fund charges, as a % of your money. Lower means more stays with you.

returns.short: How much your investment grew or shrank. Past returns never guarantee future returns.
